explainer_content.short_definition: 2020s rock discovery where post-punk angles, indie wit, and hardcore urgency make guitar bands feel current again.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Fontaines D.C., Turnstile, Wet Leg, IDLES, Yard Act, Amyl and the Sniffers, and related acts renew rock through post-punk, punk, and indie-rock scenes.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains current rock as a live-band discovery lane rather than a nostalgia-only format.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The energy is tense, dry, and scene-specific; the hooks often arrive through attitude as much as melody.
